claim.claim-text: 2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the alignment guide comprises a ramp member (57) and wherein an outer face of the ramp member coincides with the outer face of the disc shoulder at the guide location, and wherein the ramp member extends along the seed side of the seed disc in the disc rotational direction and curves toward the disc rotational axis from an outer end of the ramp member at the guide location to an inner end of the ramp member.
3. The apparatus of claim 2, comprising a plurality of ramp members, each ramp member extending outward from one of a like plurality of guide locations equally spaced along the disc shoulder.

4. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the alignment guide comprises a guide bar (58) and wherein an outer surface of the guide bar coincides with the outer face (55') of the disc shoulder at the guide location, and wherein the singulator element comprises a ramp surface sloping outward from the inner edge of the singulator element in a direction opposite to the disc rotation direction.
5. The apparatus of claim 4, comprising a plurality of guide bars, each guide bar extending outward from one of a like plurality of guide locations equally spaced along the disc shoulder.
6. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 - 5, wherein the singulating element is releasably attached to the axial bias element by magnetic attraction.
7. The apparatus of claim 6, wherein the magnetic attraction is provided by a first magnet (67) fixed to the axial bias element (63), and a second magnet (69) fixed to the singulator element.

8. The apparatus of claim 7, wherein the first magnet (67) is mounted in a magnet case (71) and where the magnet case and singulator element comprise interlocking protrusions (73) and corresponding recesses (75) configured to maintain the magnet case in a desired position with respect to the singulator element.

9. A method for aligning a singulator element on a seed disc (5) of a singulating meter, where the singulating meter comprises a meter housing (3) comprising a seed housing portion (7A) and vacant housing portion (7B), the method comprising:

10. The method of claim 9, wherein the outward force is exerted by an alignment guide (57) extending laterally outward from a guide location on the disc shoulder and bearing against the singulator element as the seed disc rotates in the disc rotation direction.

11. The method of claim 10, wherein the alignment guide comprises a ramp member (57) and wherein an outer face of the ramp member coincides with the outer face of the disc shoulder at the guide location, and wherein the ramp member extends along the seed side of the seed disc in the disc rotational direction and curves toward the disc rotational axis from an outer end of the ramp member at the guide location to an inner end of the ramp member, and wherein the inner edge of the singulator element bears against the ramp member when the seed disc rotates in the disc rotation direction.

12. The method of claim 10, wherein the alignment guide comprises a guide bar (58) and wherein an outer surface of the guide bar coincides with the outer face of the disc shoulder at the guide location, and wherein the singulator element comprises a ramp surface sloping outward from the inner edge of the singulator element in a direction opposite to the disc rotation direction, and wherein the ramp surface bears against the guide bar when the seed disc rotates in the disc rotation direction.

13. The method of any one of claims 10- 12, comprising providing a plurality of alignment guides, each alignment guide extending outward from one of a like plurality of guide locations equally spaced along the disc shoulder.
14. The method of any one of claims 10 - 13, comprising magnetically attaching the singulator element to the axial bias element.
